get.summary: Returns a collection of customers

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: Visibility status to filter activities (1=visible, 2=hidden, 3=both)

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: The result order. Allowed values: ASC, DESC (default: ASC)

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: The field by which results will be ordered. Allowed values: id, name (default: name)

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Free search term

200.description: Returns a collection of customer entities

get.summary: Returns a collection of projects.

parameters.name: customer
parameters.description: Customer ID to filter projects

parameters.name: customers
parameters.description: Comma separated list of customer IDs to filter projects

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: Visibility status to filter projects. Allowed values: 1=visible, 2=hidden, 3=both (default: 1)

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Only projects that started before this date will be included. Allowed format: HTML5 (default: now, if end is also empty)

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Only projects that ended after this date will be included. Allowed format: HTML5 (default: now, if start is also empty)

parameters.name: ignoreDates
parameters.description: If set, start and end are completely ignored. Allowed values: 1 (default: off)

parameters.name: globalActivities
parameters.description: If given, filters projects by their 'global activity' support. Allowed values: 1 (supports global activities) and 0 (without global activities) (default: all)

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: The result order. Allowed values: ASC, DESC (default: ASC)

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: The field by which results will be ordered. Allowed values: id, name, customer (default: name)

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Free search term

200.description: Returns a collection of project entities

parameters.name: projects
parameters.description: Comma separated list of project IDs to filter activities

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: Visibility status to filter activities. Allowed values: 1=visible, 2=hidden, 3=all (default: 1)

parameters.name: globals
parameters.description: Use if you want to fetch only global activities. Allowed values: true (default: false)

parameters.name: globalsFirst
parameters.description: Deprecated parameter, value is not used any more

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: The field by which results will be ordered. Allowed values: id, name, project (default: name)

parameters.name: order

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Free search term

get.summary: Returns a collection of timesheet records

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User ID to filter timesheets. Needs permission 'view_other_timesheet', pass 'all' to fetch data for all user (default: current user)

parameters.name: customer
parameters.description: DEPRECATED: Customer ID to filter timesheets (will be removed with 2.0)

parameters.name: customers
parameters.description: Comma separated list of customer IDs to filter timesheets

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: DEPRECATED: Project ID to filter timesheets (will be removed with 2.0)

parameters.name: projects
parameters.description: Comma separated list of project IDs to filter timesheets

parameters.name: activity
parameters.description: DEPRECATED: Activity ID to filter timesheets (will be removed with 2.0)

parameters.name: activities
parameters.description: Comma separated list of activity IDs to filter timesheets

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page to display, renders a 404 if not found (default: 1)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The amount of entries for each page (default: 50)

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma separated list of tag names

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: The field by which results will be ordered. Allowed values: id, begin, end, rate (default: begin)

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: The result order. Allowed values: ASC, DESC (default: DESC)

parameters.name: begin
parameters.description: Only records after this date will be included (format: HTML5)

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Only records before this date will be included (format: HTML5)

parameters.name: exported
parameters.description: Use this flag if you want to filter for export state. Allowed values: 0=not exported, 1=exported (default: all)

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Filter for running/active records. Allowed values: 0=stopped, 1=active (default: all)

parameters.name: billable
parameters.description: Filter for non-/billable records. Allowed values: 0=non-billable, 1=billable (default: all)

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: Allows to fetch fully serialized objects including subresources. Allowed values: true (default: false)

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Free search term

parameters.name: modified_after
parameters.description: Only records changed after this date will be included (format: HTML5). Available since Kimai 1.10 and works only for records that were created/updated since then.

200.description: Returns a collection of timesheets records. Be aware that the datetime fields are given in the users local time including the timezone offset via ISO 8601.

post.description: Creates a new timesheet record for the current user and returns it afterwards.

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: Allows to fetch fully serialized objects including subresources (TimesheetEntityExpanded). Allowed values: true (default: false)

200.description: Returns the new created timesheet

200.description: Returns the collection of active timesheet records for the current user

get.summary: Returns the collection of recent user activities

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User ID to filter timesheets. Needs permission 'view_other_timesheet', pass 'all' to fetch data for all user (default: current user)

parameters.name: begin
parameters.description: Only records after this date will be included. Default: today - 1 year (format: HTML5)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The amount of entries (default: 10)

200.description: Returns the collection of recent user activities (always the latest entry of a unique working set grouped by customer, project and activity)

get.summary: Returns one timesheet record

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Timesheet record ID to fetch

200.description: Returns one timesheet record. Be aware that the datetime fields are given in the users local time including the timezone offset via ISO 8601.

patch.description: Update an existing timesheet record, you can pass all or just a subset of the attributes.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Timesheet record ID to update

200.description: Returns the updated timesheet

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Timesheet record ID to delete

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Timesheet record ID to stop

200.description: Stops an active timesheet record and returns it afterwards.

patch.summary: Restarts a previously stopped timesheet record for the current user

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Timesheet record ID to restart

copy.description: Whether data should be copied to the new entry. Allowed values: all, tags (deprecated), rates (deprecated), description (deprecated), meta (deprecated) (default: nothing is copied)

begin.description: Changes the restart date to the given one (default: now)

200.description: Restarts a timesheet record for the same customer, project, activity combination. The current user will be the owner of the new record. Kimai tries to stop running records, which is expected to fail depending on the configured rules. Data will be copied from the original record if requested.
